title: SpectralCanary: Embarrassingly Simple Low-Frequency Traces for T2I Dataset-Use Auditing
title_zh: SpectralCanary：用于T2I数据集使用审计的极其简单的低频痕迹

paragraphs.en: Preprint \paperlink [globe]Projecthttps://hosytuyen.github.io/projects/SpectralCanary \paperlink [code]Code repositoryhttps://github.com/hosytuyen/SpectralCanary \paperemail stho@umd.edu \affiliations \apaffiliation \affmark 1University of Maryland \abstracttext Auditing whether a text-to-image (T2I) model was fine-tuned on a particular image collection is difficult: a model can absorb collection-level visual characteristics without reproducing training images. Proactive dataset-use auditing plants a shared signal in a dataset before release, then later checks whether that signal appears in a suspect model’s generated outputs. Existing approaches often trade off verifiability, fidelity, robustness, and deployability. We introduce SpectralCanary , which uses a smooth low-pass mask to blend a fixed canary image into every collection image while leaving captions unchanged and requiring neither auxiliary generation nor per-image optimization. A lightweight verifier detects the transferred signal in suspect-model outputs. Across eight tests on the Pokemon dataset and three realistic data transformations, spanning two architectures families, SpectralCanary achieves the highest average per-generation TPR@ 1 % 1\% FPR ( 91.1 % 91.1\% ) and fixed threshold model-level accuracy using 30 generations ( 94.8 % 94.8\% ) among the evaluated methods. Across five datasets spanning artistic, medical, satellite, and fashion domains with SD3.5, SpectralCanary averages 92.4 % 92.4\% per-generation TPR@ 1 % 1\% FPR while preserving the released images (SSIM 0.989 0.989 , LPIPS 0.022 0.022 ) with a near-zero mean change FID (mean Δ \Delta FID 0.05 0.05 ) across datasets. Matched-energy ablations on Pokemon and ROCOv2 support our design choice, low-frequency placement transfers more reliably compared to mid/high-frequency placement. Under the evaluated adaptive attacks, the most effective removal requires aggressive modification and incurs more than 25 25 Δ \Delta FID points. These results identify low-frequency visual signals as effective carriers for collection-level T2I audit traces.
paragraphs.zh: 预印本 \paperlink [globe] 项目页面https://hosytuyen.github.io/projects/SpectralCanary \paperlink [code] 代码仓库https://github.com/hosytuyen/SpectralCanary \paperemail stho@umd.edu \affiliations \apaffiliation \affmark 1马里兰大学 \abstracttext 审计一个文生图（T2I）模型是否在特定图像集合上进行了微调是困难的：模型可能在不复现训练图像的情况下吸收集合层面的视觉特征。 主动式数据集使用审计在数据集发布前在其中植入一个共享信号，之后检查该信号是否出现在可疑模型生成的输出中。 现有方法往往在可验证性、保真度、鲁棒性和可部署性之间进行权衡。 我们提出 SpectralCanary，它使用平滑的低通掩码将一张固定的金丝雀图像融合到集合中的每张图像里，同时保持标题不变，并且既不需要辅助生成也不需要逐图优化。 一个轻量级验证器在可疑模型的输出中检测被迁移的信号。 在 Pokemon 数据集上的八次测试以及三种真实数据变换下，跨越两个架构系列，SpectralCanary 在所评估的方法中取得了最高的平均逐生成 TPR@1% FPR（91.1%）以及使用 30 次生成的固定阈值模型级准确率（94.8%）。 在使用 SD3.5、涵盖艺术、医学、卫星和时尚领域的五个数据集上，SpectralCanary 的平均逐生成 TPR@1% FPR 为 92.4%，同时保留了发布的图像（SSIM 0.989，LPIPS 0.022），且跨数据集的平均 FID 变化接近于零（平均 ΔFID 0.05）。 在 Pokemon 和 ROCOv2 上的匹配能量消融实验支持我们的设计选择：与中/高频放置相比，低频放置的信号迁移更可靠。 在所评估的自适应攻击下，最有效的移除方式需要激进的修改，并带来超过 25 个 ΔFID 点的代价。 这些结果将低频视觉信号确定为集合层面 T2I 审计痕迹的有效载体。

paragraphs.en: Creative and scientific image collections embody substantial human labor, expertise, and investment. Adapting text-to-image (T2I) models to such collections can support legitimate personalization, education, design, and scientific communication [ 26 , 7 , 11 ] . The same capability, however, allows a third party to fine-tune and deploy a model on a collection without the rights holder’s consent, attribution, or compensation. Because a model can absorb a collection’s visual characteristics without reproducing individual images, rights holders may have little evidence that their work was used [ 21 , 13 ] . Practical dataset-use auditing can strengthen accountability and licensing compliance while allowing images to remain available for legitimate use.
paragraphs.zh: 创意与科学图像collection凝聚了大量的人类劳动、专业知识和投入。 将文本到图像（T2I）模型适配到这类collection上，可以支持合法的个性化、教育、设计和科学传播 [ 26 , 7 , 11 ] 。 然而，同样的能力也使第三方能够在未经权利持有人同意、署名或补偿的情况下，基于某个collection对模型进行微调并部署。 由于模型可以吸收一个collection的视觉特征而无需复制单张图像，权利持有人可能几乎没有证据表明其作品被使用 [ 21 , 13 ] 。 实用的数据集使用审计可以增强问责性和许可合规性，同时让图像继续可用于合法用途。

paragraphs.en: We study proactive dataset-use auditing, commonly termed data traceability or unauthorized data-use verification in prior works. A practical method should satisfy four requirements. (Req. 1) Collection-level verifiability. It should provide evidence from black-box outputs even when no training image is reproduced. (Req. 2) Fidelity and utility preservation. Protected samples should preserve their original appearance and the utility of models trained on them, avoiding harm to legitimate use while resisting easy filtering. (Req. 3) Pipeline robustness. The trace should remain detectable across model architectures, after augmentation such as image regeneration or recaptioning. (Req. 4) Operational deployability. The protection transform should be model-agnostic and scale efficiently to large collections without auxiliary generation or iterative per-image optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究主动式数据集使用审计，在已有工作中通常称为数据溯源或未授权数据使用验证。 一个实用的方法应当满足四项要求。 （要求 1）集合级可验证性。 即使没有任何训练图像被复现，它也应能从黑盒输出中提供证据。 （要求 2）保真度与效用保持。 受保护样本应保持其原有外观以及基于它们训练的模型的效用，在抵御轻易过滤的同时避免损害合法使用。 （要求 3）流程鲁棒性。 在经历图像再生成或重新描述等增强之后，该痕迹应能在不同模型架构间保持可检测。 （要求 4）运营可部署性。 该保护变换应与模型无关，并能高效扩展至大规模数据集，而无需辅助生成或逐图像的迭代优化。

paragraphs.en: Prior approaches typically sacrifice at least one requirement. Reactive auditing: limited collection-level evidence (Req. 1). Membership and similarity tests rely on sample-specific evidence that generalization may erase [ 21 , 13 ] . Pixel-level watermarks: limited robustness (Req. 3). Weak signals may be attenuated by augmentation, regeneration, or fail to transfer across model backbones [ 34 , 13 ] . Explicit canaries: fidelity and robustness trade-offs (Reqs. 2–3). Repeated templates can be conspicuous and filterable, while recaptioning can remove textual triggers [ 25 ] . Adjacent data-poisoning objectives. Poisoning induces chosen behavior rather than provides evidence of dataset use. Persistent behavior may not be unique or reliably elicited, so it does not by itself establish use of a particular collection [ 33 , 12 ] . Across proactive methods, auxiliary generation, filtering, and iterative optimization can also limit deployability (Req. 4) by increasing computational cost or requiring external models, domain-specific assumptions [ 25 , 13 , 12 ] . These limitations motivate a subtle, transferable, caption-independent, and inexpensive trace.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的方法通常至少牺牲其中一项要求。 响应式审计：集合层面的证据有限（要求 1）。 成员推断与相似性测试依赖于样本特定的证据，而这种证据可能被泛化所抹除 [ 21 , 13 ] 。 像素级水印：鲁棒性有限（要求 3）。 微弱信号可能被数据增强或再生成所削弱，或无法跨模型骨干网络迁移 [ 34 , 13 ] 。 显式金丝雀：保真度与鲁棒性之间的权衡（要求 2–3）。 重复的模板可能十分显眼且易于被过滤，而重新生成描述则可能移除文本触发器 [ 25 ] 。 相邻的数据投毒目标。 投毒诱导的是特定行为，而非提供数据集被使用的证据。 持久的行为可能并不独特，也未必能被可靠地激发，因此其本身并不能证明某个特定数据集被使用 [ 33 , 12 ] 。 在各类主动式方法中，辅助生成、过滤和迭代优化还会增加计算成本或需要外部模型、领域特定假设，从而限制可部署性（要求 4）[ 25 , 13 , 12 ] 。 这些局限促使我们寻求一种隐蔽、可迁移、不依赖描述且低成本的痕迹。

paragraphs.en: We propose SpectralCanary , whose key design choice is the frequency band used for the shared trace. Before release, the dataset owner chooses one fixed canary image. For each collection image, SpectralCanary mixes a small amount of the canary’s low-frequency Fourier content into the original while retaining most of its spectrum and leaving its caption unchanged (Fig. 1 (b)). The protected spectra are thereby shifted toward a common low-frequency target, creating a collection-level signal. Low frequencies encode broad spatial structure that neural networks preferentially learn [ 24 , 37 ] and that is important to T2I generation [ 39 , 17 ] . This motivates our hypothesis that a weak low-frequency trace can transfer during fine-tuning. The dataset owner then queries a suspect model and uses a lightweight verifier to test whether its generated outputs contain the trace (Fig. 1 (a)). Importantly, SpectralCanary uses a single deterministic transform requiring no caption changes, auxiliary generator, or per-image optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SpectralCanary，其关键设计选择是用于共享痕迹的频段。 在发布之前，数据集所有者选择一张固定的金丝雀图像。 对于每张集合图像，SpectralCanary 将金丝雀的少量低频傅里叶内容混入原图，同时保留其大部分频谱并保持其标题不变（图 1 (b)）。 由此，受保护的频谱被移向一个共同的低频目标，从而形成集合层面的信号。 低频编码了神经网络优先学习的广泛空间结构 [24, 37]，且该结构对文本到图像生成十分重要 [39, 17]。 这引出了我们的假设：微弱的低频痕迹可以在微调过程中迁移。 随后，数据集所有者查询可疑模型，并使用轻量级验证器测试其生成的输出中是否包含该痕迹（图 1 (a)）。 重要的是，SpectralCanary 使用单一确定性变换，无需更改标题、辅助生成器或逐图优化。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate all four requirements. Robustness tests cover a convolutional latent-diffusion U-Net [ 26 ] , a transformer-based rectified-flow model [ 7 ] ; data augmentation, image regeneration [ 42 ] , and recaptioning. Direct baselines include pixel-level traces (SIREN [ 13 ] , DIAGNOSIS [ 34 ] ) and explicit canaries (EnTruth [ 25 ] ). We also adapt Silent Branding [ 12 ] but report its evaluation separately in Appx. Q , because it targets visual branding rather than dataset-use auditing.

paragraphs.en: Auditing effectiveness and robustness. For per-generation discrimination, AUC measures verifier-score separation, while TPR at 1% FPR measures detection of outputs from protected-data models. Across eight Pokemon settings, SpectralCanary achieves 98.0% AUC and 91.1% TPR. In fixed-threshold model-level verification using 30 generations, it achieves 94.8% average accuracy under the same settings. Fidelity and utility preservation. SSIM and LPIPS compare original and protected images, while Δ \Delta FID measures the change in generative quality. Across five visual domains with SD3.5, SpectralCanary achieves 99.5 % 99.5\% AUC and 92.4 % 92.4\% TPR with SSIM 0.989 0.989 , LPIPS 0.022 0.022 , with a near-zero mean change FID ( Δ \Delta FID 0.05 0.05 ). On sparse Sketch-Scene drawings, it achieves 100 % 100\% AUC and TPR with SSIM 0.997 0.997 and LPIPS 0.002 0.002 . Operational deployability. Protection takes 0.39 0.39 seconds per image on our CPU setup (Appx. E ). Mechanism and boundary. In matched-energy ablations on Pokemon and ROCOv2, we show that low-frequency placement transfers more reliably compared to mid/high-frequency placement. Within the evaluated adaptive attacks, effective removal requires aggressive modification and incurs more than 25 25 Δ \Delta FID points.
paragraphs.zh: 审计有效性与鲁棒性。 对于逐生成判别，AUC 衡量验证器得分的区分度，而 1% FPR 下的 TPR 衡量对来自受保护数据模型输出的检测能力。 在八个 Pokemon 设置中，SpectralCanary 达到 98.0% AUC 和 91.1% TPR。 在使用 30 个生成样本的固定阈值模型级验证中，它在相同设置下达到 94.8% 的平均准确率。 保真度与效用保持。 SSIM 和 LPIPS 比较原始图像与受保护图像，而 Δ \Delta FID 衡量生成质量的变化。 在使用 SD3.5 的五个视觉领域中，SpectralCanary 达到 99.5 % 99.5\% AUC 和 92.4 % 92.4\% TPR，SSIM 为 0.989 0.989，LPIPS 为 0.022 0.022，且 FID 平均变化接近于零（Δ \Delta FID 为 0.05 0.05）。 在稀疏的 Sketch-Scene 素描上，它达到 100 % 100\% AUC 和 TPR，SSIM 为 0.997 0.997，LPIPS 为 0.002 0.002。 实际可部署性。 在我们的 CPU 设置上，每张图像的保护耗时 0.39 0.39 秒（附录 E）。机制与边界。 在 Pokemon 和 ROCOv2 上的等能量消融实验中，我们表明与中/高频放置相比，低频放置的迁移更为可靠。 在所评估的自适应攻击中，有效移除需要激进的修改，并会带来超过 25 25 个 Δ \Delta FID 点的代价。

paragraphs.en: We identify low-frequency visual structure as an effective carrier for weak collection-level traces during T2I fine-tuning. In matched band size and perturbation energy ablations on Pokemon and ROCOv2 with SD1.5, we show that low-frequency placement yields higher per-generation TPR than mid/high-frequency placement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现低频视觉结构是 T2I 微调过程中弱采集级痕迹的有效载体。 在使用 SD1.5 于 Pokemon 和 ROCOv2 上进行的匹配频段大小与扰动能量消融实验中，我们表明低频嵌入相比中/高频嵌入能产生更高的单次生成 TPR。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SpectralCanary, a deterministic and caption-preserving spectral hybridization method. It protects each image with one inexpensive transform, requiring neither an auxiliary generator nor per-image optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SpectralCanary，一种确定性的、保留描述文本的频谱混合方法。 它只需一次开销极低的变换即可保护每张图像，既不需要辅助生成器，也不需要逐图像优化。

paragraphs.en: We jointly evaluate per-generation discrimination, KS-based multi-query auditing, fixed-threshold model-level verification, image fidelity, generative utility, robustness, and protection cost across two architecture families, five datasets, three direct auditing baselines, an adapted poisoning baseline, and three realistic data transformations. This evaluation establishes a strong empirical operating point and characterizes the boundary under adaptive spectral replacement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个架构族、五个数据集、三个直接审计基线、一个改进的投毒基线以及三种真实数据变换下，联合评估逐代判别、基于 KS 的多查询审计、固定阈值模型级验证、图像保真度、生成效用、鲁棒性与保护成本。 该评估建立了一个强有力的经验运行点，并刻画了自适应谱替换下的边界。

paragraphs.en: Design motivation. Low frequencies encode broad structure that neural networks preferentially learn [ 24 , 37 ] and that is important to T2I generation [ 39 , 17 ] . They are therefore a plausible trace carrier. However, strong modification is visible. SpectralCanary uses a smooth low-pass mask to weight frequencies and a small blending strength to control the overall change. Our controlled study in Sec. 4.5 shows low-frequency placement yields higher detection rates than mid/high-frequency placement.

paragraphs.en: Stage II: Auditing a suspect model. Let ℛ \mathcal{R} contain clean-data reference scores and 𝒫 \mathcal{P} be trigger-free audit prompts (collection captions in our experiments). For suspect model 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , we collect 𝒮 𝒢 \mathcal{S}^{\mathcal{G}} and apply a one-sided two-sample Kolmogorov–Smirnov test for larger suspect scores, rejecting at level γ \gamma . Experiments use matched clean-data models. Deployment calibrates ℛ \mathcal{R} on representative independent models. This yields the KS-based multi-query audit decision. AUC and TPR are per-generation discrimination metrics (Appx. A.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 阶段二：审计可疑模型。 设 ℛ \mathcal{R} 包含干净数据参考分数，𝒫 \mathcal{P} 为无触发器的审计提示（在我们的实验中为集合字幕）。 对于可疑模型 𝒢 \mathcal{G}，我们收集 𝒮 𝒢 \mathcal{S}^{\mathcal{G}}，并应用单侧双样本 Kolmogorov–Smirnov 检验以检测可疑分数是否偏大，在显著性水平 γ \gamma 下进行拒绝。 实验使用匹配的干净数据模型。 部署时在具有代表性的独立模型上对 ℛ \mathcal{R} 进行校准。 由此得到基于 KS 的多查询审计决策。 AUC 和 TPR 是逐代生成的判别指标（附录 A.1）。

paragraphs.en: Reactive and proactive auditing. Reactive methods test an already trained model using membership inference or similarity between generated and reference images [ 3 , 21 , 23 , 19 ] . Such evidence can weaken when fine-tuning transfers collection-level characteristics without retaining identifiable information about individual samples. Proactive methods instead modify a collection before release. Anti-learning methods aim to prevent or redirect customization [ 30 , 43 , 32 , 1 , 15 ] . Proactive traceability aims to preserve customization utility while making later use statistically auditable.
paragraphs.zh: 被动审计与主动审计。 被动方法通过成员推断或生成图像与参考图像之间的相似性来测试已训练好的模型 [3, 21, 23, 19]。 当微调传递了集合层面的特征而不保留关于单个样本的可识别信息时，这类证据可能减弱。 主动方法则是在发布之前对集合进行修改。 反学习方法旨在阻止或转移定制化 [30, 43, 32, 1, 15]。 主动可追溯性旨在在保留定制化效用的同时，使后续使用在统计上可被审计。

paragraphs.en: Proactive traceability. Pixel-level methods such as DIAGNOSIS [ 34 ] and SIREN [ 13 ] insert weak transformations or learned signals that can be detected in generated images. Their subtle signals preserve appearance, but can be attenuated by augmentation, regeneration, or model backbone changes. EnTruth instead inserts explicit canary samples containing a repeated template and textual trigger [ 25 ] . This coherent signal can transfer strongly, but the injected samples are conspicuous and caption triggers can be removed. Our direct comparisons span the two main proactive families including subtle pixel-level traces and explicit visual canary samples.
paragraphs.zh: 主动性溯源。 DIAGNOSIS [ 34 ] 和 SIREN [ 13 ] 等像素级方法会在生成图像中插入可被检测到的弱变换或学习到的信号。 它们的细微信号能保持外观，但可能被数据增广、再生成或模型骨干变化所削弱。 EnTruth 则插入包含重复模板和文本触发器的显式金丝雀样本 [ 25 ] 。 这种一致的信号可以强迁移，但被注入的样本很显眼，且标题触发器可能被移除。 我们的直接对比涵盖了两大类主动性方法，包括细微的像素级痕迹和显式的视觉金丝雀样本。

paragraphs.en: Relation to poisoning. Data poisoning induces chosen behaviors such as concept corruption, reproduction, or persistent branding [ 33 , 12 ] . Persistence alone is insufficient for auditing. Auditing instead requires a collection-specific signal detectable under ordinary, trigger-free queries with controlled false positives. SpectralCanary targets this auditing objective rather than model corruption. Appx. S provides further discussion and a method taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 与投毒的关系。 数据投毒可诱发特定行为，例如概念腐化、复现或持久性品牌印记 [33, 12]。 仅凭持久性不足以进行审计。 审计反而需要在普通的、无触发器的查询下可检测的、针对特定数据集的信号，且误报可控。 SpectralCanary 针对的是这一审计目标，而非模型腐化。附录 S 提供了进一步的讨论和方法分类。 S 提供了进一步的讨论和方法分类。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments ask four concrete questions. First, can SpectralCanary reveal that a model was trained on a protected collection, even when the model architecture or training data are changed? Second, does adding the trace visibly change the released images or make a model trained on them produce worse images? Third, is protection fast enough for a large collection? Finally, why do low frequencies matter, and what happens when an informed attacker tries to remove the trace?
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验提出四个具体问题。 第一，SpectralCanary 能否揭示一个模型曾在受保护的集合上训练过，即使模型架构或训练数据发生了改变？ 第二，添加痕迹是否会明显改变发布的图像，或使在这些图像上训练的模型生成质量更差的图像？ 第三，对于大规模集合而言，保护是否足够快？ 最后，为什么低频很重要，当知情的攻击者试图移除痕迹时会发生什么？

paragraphs.en: Datasets and models. We cover distinct image domains: charater art (Pokemon-BLIP-Captions [ 22 ] ), sparse scene drawings (Sketch-Scene [ 4 ] ), medical (ROCOv2 [ 27 ] ), satellite (RSICD [ 16 ] ), and fashion (FACAD [ 38 ] ). We fine-tune Stable Diffusion v1.5 (SD1.5) [ 26 ] and Stable Diffusion 3.5 (SD3.5) [ 7 ] . The main experiments use LoRA, a common parameter-efficient form of T2I adaptation. Appx. G repeats the key test with full-parameter fine-tuning.

paragraphs.en: How to read the metrics. We distinguish the embedded trace from two evaluation levels. Per-generation discrimination scores each generated image independently and asks whether outputs from protected-data models receive higher verifier scores than outputs from clean-data models. AUC summarizes this score separation over all thresholds. TPR at 1 % 1\% FPR is the fraction of outputs from protected-data models detected at a threshold that falsely flags at most 1 % 1\% of outputs from clean-data models; thus, a TPR of 90 % 90\% means detecting about 90 of 100 protected-data-model outputs while flagging about 1 of 100 clean-data-model outputs. At the model level, we evaluate two decision protocols. KS-based multi-query auditing combines scores from 30 generated images in a statistical test and reports the rejection rate on protected-data models. Fixed-threshold model-level verification aggregates 30 generations from each held-out model and applies a threshold fixed after independent calibration, reporting TPR, FPR, precision, F1, and accuracy (Appx. H ). For image fidelity, lower LPIPS [ 41 ] means that a protected image is closer to its original. For generated-image quality, Δ ​ FID = FID protected − FID clean \Delta\mathrm{FID}=\mathrm{FID}_{\mathrm{protected}}-\mathrm{FID}_{\mathrm{clean}} [ 28 ] ; values near or below zero indicate no measured quality loss, whereas large positive values indicate degradation. Unless stated otherwise, SpectralCanary uses α = 0.02 \alpha=0.02 , c = 0.20 c=0.20 , and δ = 1 \delta=1 . Every model-training and image-sampling setting is repeated with three independent runs. Detailed protocols are in Appx. A .
paragraphs.zh: 如何阅读这些指标。 我们将嵌入式追踪与两个评估层级区分开来。 逐生成判别对每张生成的图像独立评分，并询问受保护数据模型的输出是否比干净数据模型的输出获得更高的验证器得分。 AUC 在所有阈值上汇总这种得分区分度。 1% FPR 处的 TPR 是指在某个阈值下，受保护数据模型的输出中被检测出的比例，且该阈值最多将干净数据模型 1% 的输出误判；因此，TPR 为 90% 意味着在 100 个受保护数据模型的输出中检测出约 90 个，同时误判干净数据模型 100 个输出中的约 1 个。 在模型层面，我们评估两种决策协议。 基于 KS 的多查询审计将 30 张生成图像的得分结合在一个统计检验中，并报告受保护数据模型上的拒绝率。 固定阈值的模型级验证聚合每个留存模型的 30 次生成，并应用经独立校准后固定的阈值，报告 TPR、FPR、精确率、F1 和准确率（附录 H）。 对于图像保真度，较低的 LPIPS [41] 意味着受保护图像更接近其原始图像。 对于生成图像质量，ΔFID = FID_protected − FID_clean [28]；接近或低于零的数值表示未测得质量损失，而较大的正值表示质量退化。 除非另有说明，SpectralCanary 使用 α = 0.02、c = 0.20 和 δ = 1。 每个模型训练和图像采样设置均以三次独立运行重复进行。 详细协议见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: SpectralCanary has the strongest average per-generation discrimination across the eight Pokemon settings. Fig. 2 reports per-generation TPR for both model families under ordinary training, training-time augmentation, prompt recaptioning, and image regeneration. SpectralCanary averages 91.1 % 91.1\% TPR at 1 % 1\% FPR, compared with 73.2 % 73.2\% for the next-best method. Its weakest individual result is 65.9 % 65.9\% under SD3.5 with training-time augmentation; the best competing method has a worst-case result of only 19.4 % 19.4\% . No method wins every individual setting: DIAGNOSIS is strongest for ordinary SD1.5 training, and EnTruth is strongest for SD3.5 with training-time augmentation. The complete per-generation AUC, TPR at 5 % 5\% FPR, and run-level results are in Appx. C . Appx. J separately reports KS-based multi-query auditing across query budgets, showing that more queries generally provide stronger evidence of training on protected data.

paragraphs.en: Per-generation discrimination translates well to fixed-threshold model-level verification. We aggregate 30 generations per held-out model, following Li et al. [13] , and apply a threshold independently calibrated for each method–architecture pair and fixed across transformations. Fig. 3 reports model-level accuracy across the same eight settings. Each method–architecture–transformation setting includes five clean-data and five protected-data models, yielding 320 held-out models across the four methods. paragraphs.en: We next test whether the same SpectralCanary setting works beyond Pokemon by asking three questions: Does a single generated output support reliable per-generation discrimination? Do the protected images still resemble the originals? Does training on those images degrade model outputs?
paragraphs.zh: 我们接下来测试相同的 SpectralCanary 设置在 Pokemon 之外是否有效，并提出了三个问题：单个生成的输出能否支持可靠的逐代判别？ 受保护的图像是否仍然与原图相似？ 在这些图像上训练是否会降低模型输出质量？

sents.zh: 受保护的图像是否仍然与原图相似？

paragraphs.en: SpectralCanary performs well on all three questions. At a per-generation FPR of 1 % 1\% , it achieves an average per-generation TPR of 92.4 % 92.4\% across outputs from models trained on protected data. The protected images remain close to their originals: average LPIPS is 0.022 0.022 , where zero means identical images. Training on the protected images causes almost no average change in model output quality: mean Δ \Delta FID is 0.05 0.05 , where zero means no change. On the sparse Sketch-Scene drawings, SpectralCanary achieves 100 % 100\% per-generation TPR with LPIPS 0.002 0.002 . The hardest dataset is RSICD, where it achieves 78.9 % 78.9\% per-generation TPR with LPIPS 0.048 0.048 .
paragraphs.zh: SpectralCanary 在所有三个问题上都表现良好。 在每代生成 1% 1\% 的假阳性率（FPR）下，对于在受保护数据上训练的模型所生成的输出，它实现了平均每代 92.4% 92.4\% 的真阳性率（TPR）。 受保护的图像仍接近其原始图像：平均 LPIPS 为 0.022 0.022，其中 0 表示图像完全相同。 在受保护图像上训练几乎不会导致模型输出质量的平均变化：平均 Δ \Delta FID 为 0.05 0.05，其中 0 表示没有变化。 在稀疏的 Sketch-Scene 图画上，SpectralCanary 实现了 100% 100\% 的每代真阳性率（TPR），LPIPS 为 0.002 0.002。 最困难的数据集是 RSICD，在该数据集上它实现了 78.9% 78.9\% 的每代真阳性率（TPR），LPIPS 为 0.048 0.048。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 compares all methods. Each point shows one method on one dataset. Good results appear near the upper-left corner: high per-generation TPR with little change to either the training images or the trained model’s outputs. SpectralCanary’s green points remain near this region across all five datasets. DIAGNOSIS changes the original images little but usually provides weak per-generation discrimination. SIREN works well on some datasets but poorly on others and makes the largest image changes. EnTruth works well on several datasets but fails on ROCOv2. paragraphs.en: SSIM, LPIPS, and FID capture only part of image fidelity and generative utility. Human perceptual studies and task-specific utility measurements would be needed to support stronger claims about invisibility or harmlessness. Likewise, our KS-test rejection rates on protected-data models estimate statistical power under the stated sampling protocol, while fixed-threshold model-level verification uses separate clean-data and protected-data models for calibration. A deployment would require broader calibration across representative clean-data models and should treat a positive result as statistical evidence under the threat model, not as standalone proof of unauthorized use.

paragraphs.en: SpectralCanary is intended to help data owners audit model customization, but proactive traces can also be inserted into data without the knowledge of downstream users. Responsible use requires authorization to modify the collection, disclosure where appropriate, respect for dataset licenses, and safeguards against unsupported attribution. Decisions with legal or reputational consequences should combine the audit with independent evidence.

paragraphs.en: We propose SpectralCanary, a deterministic and inexpensive approach to proactive T2I dataset-use auditing. SpectralCanary injects a weak shared visual trace through a smooth low-pass mask while leaving captions unchanged. Across eight Pokemon model–transformation settings, it provides the strongest average per-generation discrimination and reliable KS-based multi-query auditing among the evaluated methods. The same operating point generalizes across five visual domains while preserving protected-image fidelity and generative utility. Matched-energy frequency-location experiments further show that low-frequency placement transfers more consistently than mid/high-frequency placement across datasets. Finally, the adaptive evaluation identifies a scoped robustness boundary, showing that the evaluated sanitization attacks substantially reduce per-generation TPR only at the cost of considerable image-quality or generative-utility degradation. Together, these results establish SpectralCanary as a practical method for T2I dataset-use auditing, while the limitations discussed above motivate future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SpectralCanary，一种确定性强且成本低的前瞻性 T2I 数据集使用审计方法。 SpectralCanary 通过平滑的低通掩码注入一种微弱的共享视觉痕迹，同时保持文本描述不变。 在八种 Pokemon 模型转换设置中，在所评估的方法中，它提供了最强的平均单次生成辨别能力和基于 KS 的可靠多查询审计。 同一工作点可以推广到五个视觉领域，同时保持受保护图像的保真度和生成效用。 匹配能量的频率位置实验进一步表明，在各个数据集上，低频位置的迁移一致性高于中频/高频位置。 最后，自适应评估界定了一个有范围的鲁棒性边界，表明所评估的净化攻击只有在付出相当大的图像质量或生成效用下降的代价时，才能显著降低单次生成的 TPR。 总之，这些结果确立了 SpectralCanary 作为一种实用的 T2I 数据集使用审计方法，同时上文讨论的局限性也为未来工作提供了方向。

sents.en: We propose SpectralCanary, a deterministic and inexpensive approach to proactive T2I dataset-use auditing.
sents.zh: 我们提出 SpectralCanary，一种确定性强且成本低的前瞻性 T2I 数据集使用审计方法。

sents.en: SpectralCanary injects a weak shared visual trace through a smooth low-pass mask while leaving captions unchanged.
sents.zh: SpectralCanary 通过平滑的低通掩码注入一种微弱的共享视觉痕迹，同时保持文本描述不变。

sents.en: Across eight Pokemon model–transformation settings, it provides the strongest average per-generation discrimination and reliable KS-based multi-query auditing among the evaluated methods.
sents.zh: 在八种 Pokemon 模型转换设置中，在所评估的方法中，它提供了最强的平均单次生成辨别能力和基于 KS 的可靠多查询审计。

sents.en: The same operating point generalizes across five visual domains while preserving protected-image fidelity and generative utility.
sents.zh: 同一工作点可以推广到五个视觉领域，同时保持受保护图像的保真度和生成效用。

sents.en: Matched-energy frequency-location experiments further show that low-frequency placement transfers more consistently than mid/high-frequency placement across datasets.
sents.zh: 匹配能量的频率位置实验进一步表明，在各个数据集上，低频位置的迁移一致性高于中频/高频位置。

sents.en: Finally, the adaptive evaluation identifies a scoped robustness boundary, showing that the evaluated sanitization attacks substantially reduce per-generation TPR only at the cost of considerable image-quality or generative-utility degradation.
sents.zh: 最后，自适应评估界定了一个有范围的鲁棒性边界，表明所评估的净化攻击只有在付出相当大的图像质量或生成效用下降的代价时，才能显著降低单次生成的 TPR。

sents.en: Together, these results establish SpectralCanary as a practical method for T2I dataset-use auditing, while the limitations discussed above motivate future work.
sents.zh: 总之，这些结果确立了 SpectralCanary 作为一种实用的 T2I 数据集使用审计方法，同时上文讨论的局限性也为未来工作提供了方向。

paragraphs.en: Following Li et al. [13] , we evaluate whether suspect-model generations are statistically distinguishable from clean-data-model generations. Each trial independently samples a suspect query set 𝒬 b \mathcal{Q}_{b} of N q = 30 N_{q}=30 protected-data-model scores without replacement within that trial; scores may reappear across trials. The one-sided alternative follows the verifier’s score direction. For methods in which lower scores indicate protected-data use, we use the alternative below; for methods in which higher scores indicate protected-data use, its direction is reversed.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Li 等人 [13] 的做法，我们评估可疑模型生成的分数在统计上是否可与干净数据模型生成的分数区分开。 对于每种设置，我们均匀采样一个固定的干净参考集 ℛ \mathcal{R}，其中包含 300 300 个干净数据模型分数。 每次试验都在该试验内不放回地独立采样一个可疑查询集 𝒬 b \mathcal{Q}_{b}，其中包含 N q = 30 N_{q}=30 个受保护数据模型分数；分数可能在不同试验之间重复出现。 单侧备择假设遵循验证器的分数方向。 对于分数越低越表明使用了受保护数据的方法，我们使用下述备择假设；对于分数越高越表明使用了受保护数据的方法，其方向则相反。

paragraphs.en: As there is no official code, we follow its shared-template pipeline. Candidate templates use the prompts “billboard for big sale”, “a painting with a frame”, “photo frame with a family”, “a window with mountains outside”. Foregrounds use “fruits for sale” and “fruit stand”, with 50 50 images per foreground prompt and one per template prompt, generated by SD1.5. The hard trigger is “[Tgr]”, the soft trigger keyword is “fruit”. The injected samples rate is 0.5 % 0.5\% . paragraphs.en: We use the fixed RGB canary in Fig. 1 (b). Protection is applied at the stored image resolution before downstream resizing or transformations. We convert to sRGB, scale channels to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , resize the canary with antialiased bicubic interpolation, apply the unitary channel-wise transform, discard numerical imaginary residue, clip to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , quantize to 8-bit RGB, and save lossless PNG files. Defaults are δ = 1 \delta=1 , α = 0.02 \alpha=0.02 , and c = 0.20 c=0.20 . For δ < 1 \delta<1 , the run seed selects subset ℐ δ \mathcal{I}_{\delta} for both protection and verifier training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用图 1 (b) 中的固定 RGB 金丝雀水印。 保护在存储图像的分辨率上施加，然后再进行下游的缩放或变换。 我们转换到 sRGB，将各通道缩放到 [0,1]，使用抗锯齿的双三次插值缩放金丝雀水印，施加酉通道变换，舍弃数值上的虚部残留，裁剪到 [0,1]，量化为 8 位 RGB，并保存无损 PNG 文件。 默认值为 δ = 1、α = 0.02 和 c = 0.20。 对于 δ < 1，运行种子会选择子集 ℐ_δ，同时用于保护和验证器训练。

paragraphs.en: We initialize an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 [ 9 ] with a binary head. Source indices are split 80 / 20 80/20 before pairing, so each original and protected counterpart stays in the same partition. Inputs are resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 and ImageNet-normalized without stochastic augmentation. We fine-tune all layers with AdamW, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch size 32 32 , and 20 20 epochs, selecting the lowest validation-loss checkpoint. Each dataset and run trains a separate verifier without T2I generations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个带有二分类头的 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet-50 [9] 进行初始化。 在配对之前，源索引按 80 / 20 80/20 划分，因此每个原始样本与受保护对应样本保持在同一分区中。 输入被调整为 224 × 224 224\times 224 并进行 ImageNet 归一化，不使用随机数据增强。 我们使用 AdamW 微调所有层，学习率为 10 − 4 10^{-4}，权重衰减为 10 − 4 10^{-4}，批大小为 32 32，训练 20 20 个轮次，并选择验证损失最低的检查点。 每个数据集和每次运行都训练一个单独的验证器，不使用 T2I 生成结果。

paragraphs.en: SpectralCanary protects an image with one FFT-based blend followed by an inverse transform. It requires neither iterative optimization nor an auxiliary generative model. Because the baselines use different protection pipelines, operation counts are not directly comparable, where SIREN optimizes a learned watermark, Silent Branding fine-tunes a DreamBooth model and performs region selection and iterative refinement, and EnTruth generates and filters auxiliary samples. We therefore measure the end-to-end time required to produce each protected dataset on identical hardware. GPU measurements use one NVIDIA RTX A6000 with eight CPU cores; CPU-only measurements use the same system with the GPU disabled.
paragraphs.zh: SpectralCanary 通过一次基于 FFT 的混合加一次逆变换来保护图像。 它既不需要迭代优化，也不需要辅助生成模型。 由于各基线方法使用不同的保护流程，操作次数无法直接比较：SIREN 优化一个学习到的水印，Silent Branding 微调一个 DreamBooth 模型并进行区域选择和迭代细化，而 EnTruth 生成并过滤辅助样本。 因此，我们在相同硬件上测量生成每个受保护数据集所需的端到端时间。 GPU 测量使用一块 NVIDIA RTX A6000 配八个 CPU 核心；仅 CPU 测量使用同一系统并禁用 GPU。

paragraphs.en: The main experiments follow Li et al. [13] and fine-tune each method for 80 epochs. To measure when the trace appears, we apply the verifier to generations from intermediate checkpoints and report per-generation AUC and TPR at a target FPR. At each checkpoint, we generate 100 matched images from the clean-data and protected-data models using the same captions. In Fig. 10 , the base models at epoch 0 are near chance (AUC ≈ 0.500 \approx 0.500 ). After five epochs, AUC reaches 0.956 0.956 and TPR at 1 % 1\% FPR reaches 0.730 0.730 ; performance approaches saturation by epochs 10–15 and remains similar through epoch 80.

paragraphs.en: The main paper evaluates SpectralCanary with LoRA fine-tuning, which is the most practical customization setting for T2I models because it requires substantially less memory and storage than updating all base-model parameters. To test robustness of the trace beyond LoRA, we additionally evaluate full-parameter fine-tuning of SD1.5 on Pokemon. We follow the same SD1.5/Pokemon setup but train the T2I models for 50 epochs.

paragraphs.en: Tab. 4 shows that SpectralCanary remains effective under full-parameter fine-tuning. paragraphs.en: Our per-generation discrimination evaluation measures how well verifier scores separate generations from clean-data and protected-data models. This protocol enables a controlled comparison across methods without threshold calibration or query aggregation. Fixed-threshold model-level verification instead translates aggregated per-generation scores into a model-level decision that answers: was a suspect model trained on the protected dataset?
paragraphs.zh: 我们的逐代判别评估衡量验证器分数区分干净数据模型与受保护数据模型生成结果的能力。 该协议无需阈值校准或查询聚合即可实现跨方法的受控比较。 固定阈值的模型级验证则将聚合后的逐代分数转化为模型级决策，回答：可疑模型是否在受保护数据集上训练过？

For each dataset, we select three different canaries and evaluate each canary under the low-, mid-, and high-frequency conditions. Tab. 6 reports results averaged across the three canaries. Low-band coating is consistently strongest, especially at low FPR. Mid-frequency coating is markedly weaker on both datasets. High-frequency coating is somewhat competitive on Pokemon but degrades substantially on ROCOv2. paragraphs.en: IAAFT randomizes the spatial organization of the fruit canary while preserving its empirical RGB value distribution and closely matching its channel-wise Fourier magnitude. Because the controls are constructed as real valued images before applying ℱ c \mathcal{F}_{c} , their spectra satisfy the required conjugate symmetry by construction. The fixed control uses the same IAAFT realization for every protected image. The independent control uses a different realization for each image. This comparison shows the contribution of natural spatial structure while approximately controlling spectral magnitude and pixel-value distribution. We characterize how well the spectral protection signal is learned by applying the verifier to generated samples and reporting AUC and TPR@FPR.
paragraphs.zh: IAAFT 在保持水果金丝雀的经验 RGB 值分布并紧密匹配其逐通道傅里叶幅值的同时，随机化其空间组织结构。 由于这些对照在应用 ℱ c \mathcal{F}_{c} 之前被构造为实值图像，它们的频谱在构造上即满足所需的共轭对称性。 固定对照对每张受保护图像使用同一个 IAAFT 实现版本。 独立对照对每张图像使用不同的实现版本。 这一比较在近似控制频谱幅值和像素值分布的同时，展示了自然空间结构的贡献。 我们通过将验证器应用于生成样本并报告 AUC 和 TPR@FPR，来刻画频谱保护信号被学习到的程度。

Coherent natural structure therefore improves strict-FPR performance in this experiment but is not necessary for trace transfer.

paragraphs.en: We visualize EnTruth’s injected and protected samples for the Pokemon setting in Fig. 20 . The injected samples are visually distinct from the original collection and require explicit trigger tokens in their captions. Moreover, EnTruth protects a dataset by inserting auxiliary templated samples rather than preserving the content of the original samples. For curated collections such as artwork datasets, these synthetic templated images may be inconsistent with the original data distribution, reducing dataset-level fidelity and making the protection easier to identify.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在图 20 中可视化展示 EnTruth 在 Pokemon 设置下注入的样本和受保护的样本。 注入样本在视觉上与原始数据集明显不同，并且需要在标题中加入显式的触发词。 此外，EnTruth 通过插入辅助的模板化样本来保护数据集，而不是保留原始样本的内容。 对于艺术品数据集这类经过精选的数据集而言，这些合成的模板化图像可能与原始数据分布不一致，从而降低数据集级别的保真度，并使保护措施更容易被识别。

paragraphs.en: We test whether Silent Branding [ 12 ] can be repurposed for dataset-use auditing under the Pokemon protocol. We preserve its pipeline: Stage 1 trains a personalized diffusion model on the method’s logo set; Stage 2 selects plausible regions in Pokemon images and refines the inserted logo using detection, masking, and inpainting. We then fine-tune SD1.5 and SD3.5 on the edited dataset. Tab. 8 reports per-generation discrimination, and Tab. 3 reports KS-based multi-query auditing performance and protection time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试 Silent Branding [ 12 ] 是否可以在 Pokemon 协议下被重新用于数据集使用审计。 我们保留其流程：阶段 1 在该方法的标志集上训练一个个性化扩散模型；阶段 2 在 Pokemon 图像中选择看似合理的区域，并利用检测、掩码和图像修复对插入的标志进行精修。 随后我们在编辑后的数据集上微调 SD1.5 和 SD3.5。 表 8 报告了逐次生成的判别结果，表 3 报告了基于 KS 的多查询审计性能与保护时间。

paragraphs.en: Silent Branding depends on finding semantically appropriate regions and on auxiliary models for logo placement, detection, and refinement. In the Pokemon setting, its inserted signal transfers less consistently than SpectralCanary’s shared spectral component. This experiment shows that the evaluated branding pipeline is a weaker dataset-use auditing baseline under this protocol; it does not establish that all semantic insertion methods are unsuitable for dataset-use auditing.
paragraphs.zh: 静默品牌植入依赖于查找语义上合适的区域，并依赖于用于徽标放置、检测与精修的辅助模型。 在宝可梦设定中，其插入信号的传递一致性低于 SpectralCanary 的共享频谱分量。 该实验表明，在此协议下所评估的品牌植入流水线是一个较弱的数据集使用审计基线；这并不能证明所有语义插入方法都不适用于数据集使用审计。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 1 gives separate objective-specific carrier weights. For SD1.5-style noise prediction, the mean-shift weight is G ε ​ ( f ) G_{\varepsilon}(f) ; for the SD3.5-style linear flow-matching target, it is G RF ​ ( f ) G_{\mathrm{RF}}(f) . At each fixed interior noise level, both weights are maximized when the corresponding frequency has signal-to-noise ratio one, although their integration over training timesteps differs. This supports an intermediate-band mechanism but does not imply identical optimal mask scales for the two objectives. In Fig. 9 , c = 0.20 c=0.20 is a near-saturating efficiency–bandwidth choice, while c = 1.00 c=1.00 gives marginally higher traceability by modifying a broader frequency range; c = 0.05 c=0.05 is too narrow to provide the same trace strength. This comparison remains qualitative because the coating is applied in pixel space whereas SD1.5 and SD3.5 train in learned latent spaces, and the ablation changes total trace energy rather than holding the normalized budget fixed. paragraphs.en: Reactive auditing. Reactive methods leave the released data unchanged and later test whether a model was trained on it. Membership inference estimates whether a particular image or prompt–image pair belonged to the training set; recent work studies this problem for fine-tuned diffusion models in black-box settings [ 3 , 21 , 44 , 45 ] . RECOVER [ 35 ] instead identifies individual fine-tuning images through their increased robustness under stochastic inversion–reconstruction, without modifying the images or requiring the pre-fine-tuned model. Other methods compare generated images with protected examples using representations such as CLIP [ 23 ] or DINO [ 19 ] . These methods apply to collections that have already been published, but their evidence can weaken when a T2I model generalizes without retaining identifiable information about individual samples [ 13 , 25 , 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 事后审计（reactive auditing）。 事后方法不修改已发布的数据，而是在之后检测某个模型是否在其上训练过。 成员推断用于估计某张特定图像或提示词–图像对是否属于训练集；近期工作研究了针对微调扩散模型在黑盒设置下的这一问题 [ 3 , 21 , 44 , 45 ] 。 RECOVER [ 35 ] 则通过在随机反演–重建下鲁棒性的提升来识别单个微调图像，无需修改图像，也无需微调前的模型。 其他方法使用 CLIP [ 23 ] 或 DINO [ 19 ] 等表示，将生成的图像与受保护的样本进行比较。 这些方法适用于已经发布的集合，但当 T2I 模型发生泛化而不保留关于单个样本的可识别信息时，其证据可能被削弱 [ 13 , 25 , 14 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Proactive protection and auditing. Anti-learning methods, including Glaze [ 30 ] , AdvDM [ 43 ] , Anti-DreamBooth [ 32 ] , FastProtect [ 1 ] , and MetaCloak [ 15 ] , modify images to prevent or redirect unauthorized customization. Proactive dataset-use auditing instead inserts a signal intended to transfer into the customized model. Its goal is not to make fine-tuning fail, but to make outputs from a model trained on the protected collection statistically distinguishable from outputs of clean-data reference models.
paragraphs.zh: 主动式保护与审计。 反学习方法，包括 Glaze [ 30 ]、AdvDM [ 43 ]、Anti-DreamBooth [ 32 ]、FastProtect [ 1 ] 和 MetaCloak [ 15 ]，通过修改图像来阻止或转移未经授权的定制。 主动式数据集使用审计则是插入一个旨在迁移到定制模型中的信号。 其目标不是让微调失败，而是使在受保护数据集上训练的模型的输出在统计上可与非干净数据参考模型的输出区分开。

sents.en: Proactive protection and auditing.
sents.zh: 主动式保护与审计。

sents.en: Anti-learning methods, including Glaze [ 30 ] , AdvDM [ 43 ] , Anti-DreamBooth [ 32 ] , FastProtect [ 1 ] , and MetaCloak [ 15 ] , modify images to prevent or redirect unauthorized customization.

sents.en: Proactive dataset-use auditing instead inserts a signal intended to transfer into the customized model.
sents.zh: 主动式数据集使用审计则是插入一个旨在迁移到定制模型中的信号。

sents.en: Its goal is not to make fine-tuning fail, but to make outputs from a model trained on the protected collection statistically distinguishable from outputs of clean-data reference models.
sents.zh: 其目标不是让微调失败，而是使在受保护数据集上训练的模型的输出在统计上可与非干净数据参考模型的输出区分开。

paragraphs.en: Pixel-level traces. DIAGNOSIS [ 34 ] , DiffusionShield [ 6 ] , FT-Shield [ 5 ] , and SIREN [ 13 ] insert watermarks, transformations, or trigger-like signals that can later be detected in generated images. Their protected images remain close to the originals, but weak nonsemantic signals may be attenuated by image editing, regeneration, augmentation, or a change in T2I backbone. SpectralCanary shares the goal of preserving image appearance but uses a common low-frequency visual component rather than an optimized or pixel-local signal.
paragraphs.zh: 像素级痕迹。 DIAGNOSIS [ 34 ]、DiffusionShield [ 6 ]、FT-Shield [ 5 ] 和 SIREN [ 13 ] 插入水印、变换或触发器式的信号，这些信号之后可以在生成的图像中被检测到。 它们受保护的图像与原图保持接近，但微弱的非语义信号可能会因图像编辑、再生成、增强或文本到图像（T2I）骨干网络的更换而被削弱。 SpectralCanary 与之有着相同的目标，即保持图像外观，但它使用的是一种常见的低频视觉成分，而不是经过优化的或局限于像素的信号。

sents.en: Pixel-level traces.
sents.zh: 像素级痕迹。

paragraphs.en: Explicit visual canaries. EnTruth [ 25 ] inserts samples with a repeated visual template and a textual trigger. The coherent template transfers more readily than a weak pixel-level pattern, but the samples are visibly out of distribution (Appx. O ) and can be removed by visual filtering or caption cleaning. SpectralCanary instead distributes a weak version of the same visual component across the original collection and does not alter captions.
paragraphs.zh: 显式的视觉金丝雀。 EnTruth [25] 插入了带有重复视觉模板和文本触发器的样本。 这种连贯的模板比弱的像素级模式更容易转移，但这些样本明显超出分布（附录 O），并且可以通过视觉过滤或字幕清洗来移除。 （合并上述，此行按原文占位）视觉过滤或字幕清洗。 SpectralCanary 则是在原始集合中分布同一视觉组件的弱版本，并且不修改字幕。

paragraphs.en: Relation to T2I data poisoning. Dataset-use auditing and data poisoning both modify training data so that the resulting model acquires an additional behavior [ 29 , 8 , 36 , 10 ] . BBadT2I [ 40 ] implants trigger-dependent pixel-, object-, or style-level behaviors. Nightshade [ 31 ] corrupts targeted concepts through modified image–text pairs, Bilateral Data Poisoning [ 20 ] induces persistent backdoor behavior, and SilentBadDiffusion [ 33 ] elicits attacker-specified content under trigger prompts. Silent Branding [ 12 ] is especially relevant because it modifies only images and induces reproduction of a repeated visual logo without a textual trigger. We adapt it as a dataset-use auditing baseline under the same downstream fine-tuning and auditing protocol (Appx. Q ).
paragraphs.zh: 与T2I数据投毒的关系。 数据集使用审计与数据投毒都会修改训练数据，使所得模型获得一种额外的行为 [ 29 , 8 , 36 , 10 ] 。 BBadT2I [ 40 ] 会植入依赖触发器的像素级、物体级或风格级行为。 Nightshade [ 31 ] 通过修改图文对来破坏目标概念，Bilateral Data Poisoning [ 20 ] 会诱发持久的后门行为，SilentBadDiffusion [ 33 ] 则会在触发提示词下引出攻击者指定的内容。 Silent Branding [ 12 ] 与本文尤为相关，因为它仅修改图像，并在没有文本触发器的情况下诱导重复视觉标志的再现。 我们将其改造为数据集使用审计基线，并采用相同的下游微调与审计协议（附录 Q ）。
